# Instructions For Table Functionality In All The App : 
- I want the table to perform certain actions or functions in all the tabular data in the application.
- The table should allow users to sort the data by clicking on the column headers.
- The table should allow users to make inline header search on searchable columns.
- when clicking double on a row, it should navigate to a detailed view of the selected item. and it should indicate the user with background color to the selcted row .
- when clicking right click it should display to user the available actions on a table by features like edit , archive , download .
- The table should support pagination to handle large datasets, allowing users to navigate through pages of data.
